title: Evaluation case r2-utrecht-reversed: timeouts at one site while one proxy server of four is not answering, after a first step that did not help
scenario: Timeouts at one site while one proxy server of four is not answering, after a first step that did not help.

events.title: Teams times out in Utrecht
events.text: Good morning. Around 70 colleagues at the Utrecht site get a message that the connection timed out when they open Teams and sign in. It is not constant; restarting the app fixes it for some people for a while. The other sites are not affected as far as we know.

events.title: Re: Teams times out in Utrecht
events.text: Hello, sorry to hear that. Please try this on one affected PC: close Teams completely, delete the Teams cache folder and sign in again. If that does not help, a clean reinstall of the Teams app is the next step.

events.title: Re: Teams times out in Utrecht
events.text: We deleted the cache and did a full reinstall on five computers. No difference, the timeout message still comes up. The browser version of Teams fails in exactly the same way.

events.title: Re: Teams times out in Utrecht
events.text: Thanks. Next, please have a few of the affected users sign out everywhere and sign back in, so that any old sessions are dropped.

events.title: Re: Teams times out in Utrecht
events.text: We signed everyone in the pilot group out of all sessions yesterday evening and they signed in again this morning. Exactly the same failures as before.

events.title: Sign-in log check
events.text: Pulled the Entra sign-in logs and looked at the users and times you named. No failures are recorded for any of them; whatever is going wrong stops before it reaches Entra.

events.title: Proxy test
events.text: Requested login.microsoftonline.com through each of the four proxy servers of the Utrecht cluster. Three returned the page in under a second. proxy-04 timed out every single time.

events.title: Proxy server proxy-04
events.text: One of the four proxy servers, proxy-04, times out for the Microsoft sign-in addresses; the other three are fine. Was anything done on that cluster recently?

events.title: Re: Proxy server proxy-04
events.text: We rolled out a new certificate inspection profile on the cluster last Tuesday. I have taken proxy-04 out of the load balancer for now.

events.title: Re: Proxy server proxy-04
events.text: No timeouts reported since proxy-04 was taken out. I watched twenty sign-ins and all of them were fine.
